what: Plains All American gathers, transports and stores crude oil. It owns pipelines running from the Permian basin to the Gulf Coast and to storage hubs, and also handles natural gas liquids in Canada.
customers: Oil producers, refiners and marketers who pay to move and store crude oil and liquids.
moat: Gathering systems connected directly to Permian wells feeding its own long-haul pipelines, a position competitors would have to build from scratch across private land.
risks: Volumes depend on Permian drilling activity
Revenue has fallen about 8% a year over three years as crude prices came down
It is a partnership, which complicates tax reporting for some investors
opportunities: A distribution yield near 7% backed by fee-based contracts
Operating margin on fee-based activity is steady regardless of oil prices
Permian production growth keeps raising volumes through its system
watch: Permian gathered volumes and distributable cash flow coverage.
